content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"Payments calls doubled from 11:45: 212, 229, 220 and 192 calls against forecasts of about 98-100 per interval, after running close to forecast before that. P2 incident INC-20261112-1271 (IMPS/NEFT transfers stuck in 'pending' with the account already debited) was opened at 11:58, about 13 minutes after the rise began. The extra calls fall mostly under the matching reasons: payment_status_enquiry is at 2.66x normal (+265 calls), refund_status at 2.22x (+149) and upi_payment_failed at 1.54x (+60), while unrelated reasons are flat. Service level fell to 4.7-29.5% during the spike and recovered to 95.8% at 12:30 once agents on phones rose to 51 against 36 planned, but volume is still about 97% over forecast, so this needs to be held until the incident is fixed.","evidence":[{"source":"incident","ref_id":"INC-20261112-1271","summary":"P2 opened 11:58 on the IMPS/NEFT payment hub: outward transfers stuck in pending, account debited, reversal job queued.
